verses.text: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his holy place! Praise him in his mighty heavens!
Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him for his amazing greatness!
Praise him with the sound of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!
Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!
Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with crashing cymbals!
Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!
